about: Plot > Exchange X-Y axes (PlotView.exchangeXY, overrides.exchange_xy): the layer turns on its side, so X runs up the LEFT and Y along the BOTTOM, and each quantity keeps its own title, scale, limits and direction. Both legs read this table: frontend/src/lib/exchangeXY.test.ts (the screen's uPlot options) and tests/test_calc_figure_exchange_xy.py (the exported matplotlib figure). `vertical` is the axis that must end up on the left in both.

cases.name: SIMS depth profile: depth up the side, log counts along the bottom
reversed log X keeps its direction and scale on the vertical axis
no limits set: scales and titles still follow their axes
